---
title: "Historical WTI and Brent Crude Oil Prices (2000-2025)"
author: "David Avila"
date: "2026-10-26"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

Project_9_Excel_Data_Visualization_Third_Round <- read_excel("Project 9 - Excel - Data Visualization Third Round.xlsx", sheet = "Spot_Prices")

oil_data <-
  Project_9_Excel_Data_Visualization_Third_Round
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

oil_data <- Project_9_Excel_Data_Visualization_Third_Round

ggplot(oil_data, aes(x = Date)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = WTI_USD, color = "WTI"), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Brent_USD, color = "Brent"), na.rm = TRUE) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("WTI" = "orange","Brent" = "steelblue")) +
    labs(title = "Historical WTI and Brent Crude Oil Prices (2000-2025)",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Crude Oil Price (USD per Barrel)",
         color = "Oil Type",
         caption = "Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)") + 
    theme_minimal()
```

## Box Plot Analysis: WTI and Brent Crude Oil Prices
```{r}
box_data <- data.frame(
  WTI = oil_data$WTI_USD,
  Brent = oil_data$Brent_USD
)

box_long <- stack(box_data)
names(box_long) <- c("Price", "Oil_Type")

ggplot(box_long, aes(x = Oil_Type, y = Price, fill = Oil_Type)) + 
  geom_boxplot(na.rm = TRUE) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("WTI" = "steelblue","Brent"= "orange")) + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of WTI and Brent Crude Oil Prices (2000-2025)",
    x = "Oil Type",
    y = "Crude Oil Price (USD per Barrel)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```
